title: The Lanternbearer's Fox
statement: They say when the first star-maker finished lighting the sky, a small fox ran off with the last unplaced star, carrying it in her mouth like a glowing coal. The star-maker, charmed, let her keep it — and now she trots forever just ahead of dawn, her lantern-tail low, dropping one stray sparkle at each constellation she passes so no one's sky is ever entirely dark.
